reviews.rationale: Supplied TCP connection and endpoint relationships retained; no invented authentication sequence. However C2 mapping is not supported by a single connection without beaconing, reputation or other malicious evidence. This negative-control classification is a false positive despite careful body caveats and a neutral incident title; medium severity alone is not the defect. PowerShell checklist reference explains absent PowerShell rather than applicable process evidence. This is a factual/classification regression versus the baseline ambiguous legitimacy wording, not a query-contamination failure.
